title: Julia Stiles Reunites With ’10 Things I Hate About You’ Cast, Cries During Heath Ledger Tribute on ‘Dancing With the Stars’
content:
ByEmily Longeretta

90036

Julia Stilespaid tribute to the lateHeath Ledgeron Tuesday night’s episode of “Dancing With the Stars.”

During Dedication Night, she performed a contemporary routine with her partner Ezra Sosa to “Can’t Take My Eyes Off You”; in the 1999 film “10 Things I Hate About You,” Ledger’s character, Patrick, sang the Frankie Valli number to Stiles’ Kat Stratford from the bleachers while she was at soccer practice.

The routine ended with the audio of Stiles reciting the poem she read to him in the movie, as her costars Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Larisa Oleynik, Andrew Keegan, Gabrielle Union and Susan May Pratt joined her on the ballroom floor.

In the video package before her dance, she got choked up telling Sousa, “I learned a lot from Heath… It was so easy with him. I have so many great memories. I really wish I could pick up the phone, and be like, ‘Hey dude.'” She added that her response in that scene was real, and she hopes to “recreate the musk for life he had” in that scene.

She scored four nines for the routine.

Hours before the live show, Sousa shared a statement about the routine on Instagram.

“I don’t think we’ve ever approached a performance with more care, sensitivity, and intention than this one. From the very beginning, it was incredibly important to both Julia and I that this tribute be created with the utmost respect, thoughtfulness, and close guidance from those who hold Heath and his memory closest,” he wrote. “This isn’t about defining a relationship or telling a story that isn’t ours to tell. It’s about honoring a beautiful moment in time, a film that changed so many lives, and someone whose impact continues to be felt by generations. We’ve poured so much love into this piece, and we’re incredibly grateful for the trust placed in us to bring it to life. Our only hope is that it honors his memory with the dignity, love, and respect it deserves.”

Earlier in the week, Stiles opened up toVarietyabout the emotional rehearsals.

“I know that Dedication Night is emotional, but I thought I was distanced from it enough. Like, oh, it was so many years ago. Something about seeing clips from that movie and images and hearing my voice and hearing his voice is bringing back so many memories. It’s a lot,” she said, noting that she started crying while practicing. “One of the things that we really hope to do as performers is to make people feel something and have people care about the work that you do, and his memory lives on because it was such an incredible performance.”

Ledger died in January 2008 at the age of 28.
title_zh: 茱莉亞·史泰爾斯(Julia Stiles)與《我恨你的10件事》(10 Things I Hate About You)的演員重聚，在《與星共舞》(Dancing With the Stars)中為希斯·萊傑(Heath Ledger)的致敬感動落淚。
content_zh:
由艾米莉·朗格瑞塔(Emily Longeretta)報導

朱莉亞·史泰爾斯(Julia Stiles)在週二晚上的《舞動明星(Dancing With the Stars)》節目中向已故的希斯·萊傑(Heath Ledger)致敬。

在致敬之夜，她與搭檔埃茲拉·索薩(Ezra Sosa)表演了一段當代舞蹈，曲目為《Can't Take My Eyes Off You》；在1999年的電影《我恨你的十件事(10 Things I Hate About You)》中，萊傑飾演的角色帕特里克(Patrick)在看台上對著史泰爾斯飾演的凱特·斯特拉特福德(Kat Stratford)唱了這首法蘭基·瓦利(Frankie Valli)的歌曲，當時她正在進行足球訓練。

這段舞蹈以史泰爾斯在電影中朗誦的詩作音頻結束，當時她的共演者喬瑟夫·高登-李維特(Joseph Gordon-Levitt)、拉里莎·奧萊尼克(Larisa Oleynik)、安德魯·基根(Andrew Keegan)、加布里埃爾·尤尼恩(Gabrielle Union)和蘇珊·梅·普拉特(Susan May Pratt)也加入了她的舞蹈。

在她舞蹈前的視頻包中，她情緒激動地告訴索薩：“我從希斯那裡學到了很多……和他在一起是如此輕鬆。我有很多美好的回憶。我真的希望能撥通電話，說‘嘿，老兄。’”她補充說，她在那個場景中的反應是真實的，她希望能“重現他在那個場景中的生命氣息”。

她在這段舞蹈中獲得了四個9分。

在直播節目開始前幾個小時，索薩在Instagram上分享了關於這段舞蹈的聲明。

“我認為我們從未以如此謹慎、敏感和用心的方式來對待一場表演。從一開始，對於朱莉亞和我來說，這個致敬能夠以最尊重、最周到的方式創作，並得到那些最珍視希斯及其記憶的人的指導是非常重要的，”他寫道。“這不是在定義一段關係或講述不是我們的故事。這是為了紀念一個美好的時刻，一部改變了許多生命的電影，以及一位其影響力仍在幾代人中延續的人。我們在這段作品中注入了如此多的愛，我們非常感激能夠受到信任來將其呈現出來。我們唯一的希望是，這能以應有的尊嚴、愛和尊重來紀念他的記憶。”

本週早些時候，史泰爾斯向《綜藝(Variety)》談到了情感豐富的排練。

“我知道致敬之夜是情感豐富的，但我以為我與之有足夠的距離。就像，哦，那是很多年前的事。看到那部電影的片段和影像，聽到我的聲音和他的聲音讓我回憶起了很多事情。這一切都太多了，”她說，並指出她在排練時開始哭泣。“作為表演者，我們真正希望做到的事情之一就是讓人們感受到某種情感，讓人們關心你所做的工作，而他的記憶之所以延續，是因為那是一場如此不可思議的表演。”

萊傑於2008年1月去世，享年28歲。
